schema.name: products
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sku` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `stock` int NOT NULL,
  `minimum_stock` int NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `sku` (`sku`),
  CONSTRAINT `products_chk_1` CHECK (regexp_like(`sku`,_utf8mb4'^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{0,39}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `products_chk_2` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`name`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `products_chk_3` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`category`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `products_chk_4` CHECK ((`price` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `products_chk_5` CHECK ((`stock` between 0 and 1000000)),
  CONSTRAINT `products_chk_6` CHECK ((`minimum_stock` between 0 and 1000000))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

schema.name: request_locks
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `request_locks` (
  `request_key` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`request_key`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

schema.name: sale_items
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `sale_items` (
  `sale_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `product_name` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `sku` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `quantity` int NOT NULL,
  `unit_price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`sale_id`,`product_id`),
  KEY `ix_items_product` (`product_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sale_items_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`sale_id`) REFERENCES `sales` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sale_items_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sale_items_chk_1` CHECK ((`quantity` between 1 and 1000000)),
  CONSTRAINT `sale_items_chk_2` CHECK ((`unit_price` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

schema.name: sales
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `sales` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `request_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `payload_hash` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `total` decimal(22,2) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `request_id` (`request_id`),
  KEY `ix_sales_created` (`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `sales_chk_1` CHECK ((`total` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=18 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

schema.name: schema_versions
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `schema_versions` (
  `version` int NOT NULL,
  `applied_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`version`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

schema.name: stock_movements
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `stock_movements` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `product_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `delta` int NOT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs NOT NULL,
  `sale_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ix_movements_product` (`product_id`,`id` DESC),
  KEY `sale_id` (`sale_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `stock_movements_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `stock_movements_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`sale_id`) REFERENCES `sales` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `stock_movements_chk_1` CHECK ((`delta` <> 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=43 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs

schema.name: stock_requests
schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `stock_requests` (
  `request_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `payload_hash` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `resulting_stock` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`request_id`),
  KEY `product_id` (`product_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `stock_requests_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `stock_requests_chk_1` CHECK ((`resulting_stock` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_as_cs
